title: BOOKSMITH book passport v0.1
description: The machine-legible receipts object for one finished book: what it is, who wrote which parts, what the gates verified, and where the cover bytes live. Ratified 2026-08-27 between the book-smith and book-web sessions (sandbox book-estate: PASSPORT_SHAPE_2026-08-27_book-smith.md + PASSPORT_COMMENTS_2026-08-27_book-web.md). FORWARD-COMPAT CONTRACT: consumers MUST ignore unknown fields (additionalProperties stays true everywhere); removals or type changes require a passport_version bump. The 3D shelf, the AEO/receipts surface, and the colophon all read this one object.

translation_of.description: Slug of the sibling-language master, when this book is one half of an EN/ZH pair (delta 2)

public.description: Delta 3: privacy roster rule enforced in DATA. Consumers (the shelf build) MUST refuse to render any passport without public:true. Default false.

exact.description: true only when every logged call carried real usage numbers (E-4); false = estimate or no calls

checks.description: One row per configured format that has a recorded verification sweep

gates_version.description: Delta 5: kit commit short-sha the verifier ran under; a shelf card can say 'verified under <version>'

rel.description: Workspace-relative path of the composited ebook cover

sha256.description: Byte identity of the cover file; the shelf texture cache keys on this (delta 4)

method.description: Provenance method from the art sidecar: sdxl | hypergen | workers_ai_flux | bespoke | supplied | catalog | null

published.description: Basename of the cover bytes copied beside this passport at publish time (delta 4); null when not published

physical.description: Delta 1: what a 3D shelf needs to render a spine before a cover
